dialogue-no-execution.description: A read-only DIALOGUE answer must not create execution authority.

execution-proposal-confirmation.description: An explicit execution proposal must stop at durable confirmation.

fan-out-draft.description: A workflow draft must preserve one upstream node feeding two sinks without execution.

knowledge-read-citation.description: A citation must match an OK Knowledge unit fully read in the current turn.

minimax-noncase-terminal.description: A normal MiniMax execution must terminalize from authoritative workflow state without a synthetic-case disclaimer.

missing-field-correction.description: A missing field must block execution and ask the user to correct the field binding.
